purpose: Short keywords that label or categorise content, used as static labels, selectable filters or removable choices.

props.name: tags
props.type: Array<{ id: string; label: string; tone?: 'neutral' | 'primary' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' }>

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Makes tags selectable as filters. Defaults to none

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Makes tags removable; called with removed ids

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Shows the label visually. Defaults to false (label for assistive tech only)

whenToUse: As quick filters above a list
whenNotToUse: For a single status — use Badge
antiPatterns: Mixing removable and selectable behaviour in one group

anatomy: Square chips with a 1px border on a tonal container; a check when selected; a close control when removable
states: `color-container-*` with `color-on-container-*`; selected `color-container-primary` with a `color-border-interactive` border; hover `color-state-layer`; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`

a11yNotes: A grid of tags named by the label; arrows move between tags
Backspace and Delete remove the focused tag; the remove control is named Remove plus the tag
